page.layout: One page of text, single column, with page numbers printed at the right of several lines; a running head at the top; a short line "INCI-" with a woodcut ornament below it at the centre-lower part. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: Periuria.
Pietas.
main_text.p: Plus apud bonos pietatis iura quam omnes opes valent. 42.
main_text.head: Pudicitia.
main_text.p: Vera ornamenta matronarum, non vestes, sed pudicitia. 182.
main_text.head: Quies.
Victoria.
main_text.p: Insperata interdum, sperata victoria certior est. 183.
main_text.head: Vxor.
main_text.p: Vxor nubendo, non prosperæ tantum, sed omnis fortunæ cum marito init societatem. 199.

page.notes: The catchword "INCI-" is probably the start of the next section, set in larger type. The woodcut ornament is not transcribed. Several printed page numbers are small and partly obscured; the page numbers 148, 42, 182, 35, 183 and 199 are the printed marginal numbers at the line ends. The "Vxor" heading and the Latin in the Vxor line are as printed.
